es.summary: Tiempo de embarazo medido en semanas desde el primer día de la última regla (FUR). Después del nacimiento se estima con escalas como Ballard o Capurro.
key_points: Se cuenta en semanas y días desde la FUR: por ejemplo, 32 4/7 semanas.
Antes del parto se calcula con la FUR y se confirma con ultrasonido (cabeza, abdomen y fémur).
Después del parto se estima por características físicas y neuromusculares (Ballard; en Latinoamérica también Capurro).
Clasifica al RN en pretérmino (menos de 37 semanas), término (37 a 41 6/7) o postérmino (42 o más).

usage: Ejemplo: «G2P1, EG 36 2/7 semanas por ultrasonido del primer trimestre».
Se anota en cada control prenatal y al ingreso al parto.
Sirve para interpretar la AU, la FCF, la DU y el peso del RN (PEG/AEG/GEG).
nursing_care: Preguntar la FUR y verificar la FPP en el carné prenatal.
Usar la misma EG corregida en toda la historia.
Si la madre no tuvo control prenatal, la valoración del RN es clave para conocer su EG.

en.summary: How far along a pregnancy is, measured in weeks from the first day of the last menstrual period (EG in Spanish). After birth it is estimated with scales such as Ballard or Capurro.
key_points: Gestational age is measured in weeks, from the first day of the last menstrual period: for example, 32 4/7 weeks.
Before birth it is calculated from the LMP and confirmed by ultrasound (head, abdomen and thigh bone).
After birth it is estimated from external physical characteristics and neuromuscular maturity (Ballard; Capurro in Latin America).
It classifies the newborn as preterm (before 37 weeks), term (37 to 41 6/7) or postterm (42 or more).

usage: Example: "G2P1, GA 36 2/7 weeks by first-trimester ultrasound".
Recorded at each prenatal visit and on admission for birth.
Used to interpret fundal height, FHR, contractions and newborn weight (SGA/AGA/LGA).
nursing_care: Ask for the LMP and check the due date on the prenatal card.
Use the same corrected GA throughout the chart.
Assessing gestational age is especially important when the mother had limited prenatal care.

sources.name: Maternal-Newborn Nursing: Estimation of Gestational Age of the Newborn and Newborn Behavioral Assessment

summary.0.quote: It is measured in weeks, from the first day of the woman's last menstrual cycle to the current date.

key_points.1.quote: Before birth, your health care provider will use ultrasound to measure the size of the baby's head, abdomen, and thigh bone.

sections.nursing_care.2.quote: Assessing gestational age can be especially important when the birth parent has had limited prenatal care and the gestational age is unknown or unclear.
